recent_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Price Chart 2026: Historical Data, Market Analysis, and Outlook
recent_news.summary: Growing demand for renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and biodiesel production continued to strengthen the commercial importance of UCO as an alternative feedstock in the global renewable energy industry. In September 2026, the increase in the US Used Cooking Oil price index reflected the combined influence of inflationary conditions and higher production costs.

backfill_news.headline: Greasezilla FOG Separation Technology Expands Biofuel Production Capabilities
backfill_news.summary: Greasezilla's FOG separation system continues to demonstrate viability in converting brown grease and trap waste into renewable biofuel, with the energy self-sufficient system using only 5% of produced fuel internally while retaining 95% for commercial sale.

backfill_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Expands Midwest Presence with Acquisition of Darling Ingredients' Grease Trap Operations
backfill_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired the remaining grease trap service operations of Darling Ingredients Inc. (DAR PRO Solutions brand) in Ohio, expanding its commercial service capabilities in the Midwest while Darling Ingredients retains UCO collection services.
